agentkit.AppendSessionItemsRequest.description: Request to append items to a session.

items.description:
Items to append atomically in request order. Concurrent append requests are serialized into one
committed order without exposing a numeric sequence in the public contract.

session_items.description: Persisted session items with service-assigned fields.

agentkit.ClearSessionItemsRequest.description: Request to clear all items from a session.

agentkit.ClearSessionItemsResponse.description: Response from clearing items from a session.

managed_memory_entry_id.description: Optional caller-selected memory entry ID. The service generates an ID when omitted.

managed_memory_store_id.description:
Caller-provided, workspace-unique memory store ID. It must be 3-56 characters, begin
with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and end with a
letter or digit.

session.description:
The session to create. `actor_id` is required. A session with `parent_session_id` is a child and
must use its parent's `actor_id`. Independent forks are created only through `ForkSession`.

session_id.description:
Optional caller-selected session ID. The service generates a UUID when this field is omitted.
The ID must be unique; a collision returns `ALREADY_EXISTS`.

session_store_id.description:
Caller-provided, workspace-unique session store ID. It must be 3-55 characters, begin with a
lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

agentkit.ExtractMemoriesRequest.description: Request to synchronously extract memories from a single session.

dry_run.description:
When true, extract and return the entries without writing them to the memory store. Defaults
to false, which persists the extracted entries and returns them.

instructions.description: Instructions steering what is extracted from the session.

memory_store.description:
Memory store the extracted entries are written to, in the form
`memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}`.

agentkit.ExtractMemoriesResponse.description: Result of a single-session memory extraction.

entries.description: The memory entries written by this extraction.

name.description: Correlation identifier for this extraction, for logging and tracing. Not a fetchable resource.

actor_id.description: Opaque caller-provided identifier for the application actor associated with the forked session.

session_id.description: Optional unique ID for the forked session. A collision returns `ALREADY_EXISTS`.

source_session_id.description: ID of the session to copy.

up_to_item_id.description:
Optional last item ID to copy through, inclusively. When omitted, the fork atomically copies
all items committed before the fork operation begins.

view.description: Controls whether the response includes memory content. Defaults to `FULL`.

agentkit.GrantMemoryStorePermissionReque.description:
Request to grant a READ or WRITE permission on a memory store to a principal.
Only the store owner or a workspace admin may grant permissions.

principal.description: Principal to grant the permission to.

agentkit.GrantMemoryStorePermissionRespo.description: Response from granting a permission on a memory store.

agentkit.GrantSessionStorePermissionRequ.description:
Request to grant a READ or WRITE permission on a session store to a principal.
Only the store owner or a workspace admin may grant permissions.

principal.description: Principal to grant the permission to.

agentkit.GrantSessionStorePermissionResp.description: Response from granting a permission on a session store.

actor_id.description: Customer-provided identifier for the actor whose entries are listed.

page_size.description:
Maximum number of entries to return. The service may return fewer entries than requested.
Defaults to 10; must be between 1 and 100.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous ListManagedMemoryEntries response.

path_prefix.description: Optional path prefix used to restrict entries within the actor partition.

session_id.description:
Optional session identifier. When set, only entries with this exact `session_id` are
returned. Omitted-session (cross-session) entries are not included. Ignored when path is set.

view.description: Controls whether each returned entry includes memory content. Defaults to `FULL`.

managed_memory_entries.description: Memory entries matching the request and selected response view.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token. This field is omitted when there are no more results.

page_size.description:
Maximum number of stores to return. The service may return fewer stores than requested.
Defaults to 10; must be between 1 and 100.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous ListManagedMemoryStores response.

agentkit.ListManagedMemoryStoresResponse.description: Response containing memory stores in the caller's workspace.

managed_memory_stores.description: Memory stores in the caller's workspace.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token. This field is omitted when there are no more results.

page_size.description: Maximum number of permissions to return. Defaults to 100; maximum is 1000.

page_token.description: Continuation token from a previous response.

agentkit.ListMemoryStorePermissionsRespo.description: A page of explicit memory store permissions.

memory_store_permissions.description: Explicit READ or WRITE grants. Implicit owner/admin access and inherited grants are excluded.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page, omitted when all permissions have been returned.

order_by.description:
Sort order. Supported values are `create_time asc` and `create_time desc`. The default is
`create_time desc`, which returns the most recently appended items first. Equal timestamps are
resolved by committed append order in the requested direction.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 10; must be between 1 and 100.

page_token.description: Token returned by a previous list request.

agentkit.ListSessionItemsResponse.description: Response containing a page of session items.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page.

session_items.description: Session items in the requested page.

page_size.description: Maximum number of permissions to return. Defaults to 100; maximum is 1000.

page_token.description: Continuation token from a previous response.

agentkit.ListSessionStorePermissionsResp.description: A page of explicit session store permissions.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page, omitted when all permissions have been returned.

session_store_permissions.description: Explicit READ or WRITE grants. Implicit owner/admin access and inherited grants are excluded.

page_size.description: Maximum number of session stores to return. Defaults to 10; must be between 1 and 100.

page_token.description: Token returned by a previous list request.

agentkit.ListSessionStoresResponse.description: Response containing a page of session stores.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page.

session_stores.description: Session stores in the requested page.

filter.description:
Filter expression. Supported fields include `actor_id` and `metadata`; for example,
`actor_id = "support-customer-123"`.

order_by.description:
Sort order. Defaults to `last_activity_time desc`. Page-token continuation is exactly-once when
ordering by `create_time` (immutable); ordering by `last_activity_time` is best-effort, because
that value changes as a session gains activity, so a session updated between page requests may
be repeated or skipped. To enumerate every session exactly once, order by `create_time`.

page_size.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to 10; must be between 1 and 100.

page_token.description: Token returned by a previous list request.

agentkit.ListSessionsResponse.description: Response containing a page of sessions.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page.

agentkit.ManagedMemoryEntry.description: A workspace-scoped entry in a memory store.

actor_id.description: Customer-provided identifier for the actor whose memory this entry represents.

create_time.description: Time when the entry was created.

description.description: Human-readable description of the memory entry.

name.description:
Resource name in the form
`memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}/entries/{managed_memory_entry_id}`.
Required for updates; assigned by the service on creation.

path.description:
Absolute, case-sensitive path identifying the entry within its actor and optional session.
Paths must begin with `/` and must not contain empty, `.` or `..` segments.

session_id.description:
Optional identifier for the session associated with this memory entry. When omitted, the
entry applies across the actor's sessions.

source_type.description: Which writer created this entry. Caller sets this on Create; immutable after creation.

update_time.description: Time when the entry was last updated.

score.description: Relevance score for the result. Higher scores are more relevant.

agentkit.ManagedMemoryEntrySourceType.description: Identifies the source that created a memory entry.

agentkit.ManagedMemoryEntryView.description: Controls how much memory entry data is returned.

agentkit.ManagedMemoryStore.description: A workspace-scoped memory store backed by service-managed storage.

create_time.description: Time when the store was created.

creator_user_id.description:
Workspace-local user ID of the authenticated principal that created the store. This is
immutable server-set attribution and does not grant access; authorization is evaluated from
the authenticated request context.

description.description: Human-readable description of the memory store.

display_name.description:
Deprecated compatibility alias for the caller-provided memory store ID. Canonical
clients provide the ID through `CreateMemoryStoreRequest.managed_memory_store_id` and use
`name` as the resource identifier.

owner_user_id.description:
Deprecated alias for `creator_user_id`. This identifies the original creator, not a
transferable owner. Use `creator_user_id` instead.

storage_backend.description: Service-managed storage backing this memory store.

update_time.description: Time when the store was last updated.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the memory store.

agentkit.MemoryStorePermission.description: A principal's permission on a memory store.

permission.description: The permission level. WRITE includes READ; PERMISSION_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED means neither is available.

principal.description: The principal whose permission is reported.

agentkit.PermissionLevel.description: Permission level granted on a store. WRITE is a superset of READ.

agentkit.PopSessionItemRequest.description: Request to pop an item from a session.

agentkit.PrincipalType.description: The kind of Databricks principal a store permission is granted to.

agentkit.RevokeMemoryStorePermissionRequ.description: Request to revoke all explicit access to a memory store. Only the owner or a workspace admin may revoke permissions.

principal.description: Principal whose READ and WRITE grants will be removed.

agentkit.RevokeMemoryStorePermissionResp.description: Response from revoking a memory store permission.

agentkit.RevokeSessionStorePermissionReq.description: Request to revoke all explicit access to a session store. Only the owner or a workspace admin may revoke permissions.

principal.description: Principal whose READ and WRITE grants will be removed.

agentkit.RevokeSessionStorePermissionRes.description: Response from revoking a session store permission.

agentkit.SearchManagedMemoryEntriesReque.description:
Request to search memory entries by text query for one actor.
Search returns a relevance-ranked top-N result set and does not currently paginate.

actor_id.description: Customer-provided identifier for the actor whose entries are searched.

limit.description: Deprecated alias for `page_size`. When both fields are set, their values must match.

page_size.description:
Maximum number of relevance-ranked entries to return. Defaults to 10 and must be between 1 and
100.

page_token.description:
Reserved for pagination compatibility. The server currently ignores this field because Search
returns a ranked top-N result set.

path_prefix.description:
Optional absolute, case-sensitive path prefix used to restrict searched entries within the
actor partition. The prefix must begin with `/` and must not contain empty, `.` or `..`
segments.

session_id.description:
Optional session identifier. When set, only entries with this exact `session_id` are
searched. Omitted-session (cross-session) entries are not included.

view.description:
Controls whether each returned entry includes memory content. Search scores are always
returned. Defaults to `FULL`.

agentkit.SearchManagedMemoryEntriesRespo.description: Response containing memory entries ranked by relevance.

managed_memory_entries.description:
Deprecated compatibility alias for clients migrating to `results`. This contains the same
entries in the same order, but omits their relevance scores.

next_page_token.description:
Opaque pagination token. Search currently returns an unpaginated ranked top-N result set, so
the server does not populate this field.

results.description: Canonical matching entries and relevance scores, ordered most relevant first.

agentkit.Session.description: A durable logical interaction stored within a Session Store.

actor_id.description:
Opaque caller-provided identifier for the application actor associated with the session.

This is application data and has no Databricks authentication or authorization semantics.
Use the same value as the Managed Memory Entry `actor_id` when storing memories associated
with this actor. Every session must set it. A child session must use the same value as its parent.

create_time.description: Time when the session was created.

last_activity_time.description: Time when the session's item history was last mutated.

parent_session_id.description:
Immediate parent session ID. Set only at creation for child sessions, immutable thereafter, and
restricted to the same store.

root_session_id.description:
Top-level session ID in the spawn tree. This equals `session_id` for a root or fork and is
inherited transitively by child sessions.

session_id.description:
Unique session ID. The service generates a UUID unless the caller supplies
`CreateSessionRequest.session_id`.

update_time.description: Time when session resource fields last changed.

agentkit.SessionItem.description: A transcript entry in a session's history.

create_time.description:
Server-assigned time when the append commits. Values are nondecreasing within a session. Item
listing orders by this timestamp; equal timestamps are resolved by committed append order.

data.description:
Complete SDK-native, JSON-compatible item. The service stores and returns this value without
interpreting provider-specific fields such as `type`, `role`, or `content`.

create_time.description: Time when the store was created.

creator_user_id.description:
Workspace-local user ID of the authenticated principal that created the store. This is
immutable server-set attribution and does not grant access; authorization is evaluated from
the authenticated request context.

description.description: Human-readable description of the session store.

update_time.description: Time when the store was last updated.

agentkit.SessionStorePermission.description: A principal's permission on a session store.

permission.description: The permission level. WRITE includes READ; PERMISSION_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED means neither is available.

principal.description: The principal whose permission is reported.

agentkit.StorageBackend.description: Service-managed storage backing a memory store.

backend_id.description: Backend-specific identifier. For Lakebase, this is the project ID.

agentkit.StorageBackendType.description: Type of service-managed storage backing a memory store.

agentkit.StorePrincipal.description:
A principal a store permission is granted to. `name` is the principal's Lakebase
identifier: a user's email or a service principal's application (client) id.

principal_type.description: The kind of principal. Required unless the deprecated type alias is supplied.

update_mask.description: Fields to update. Only `content` and `description` may be updated.

managed_memory_store.description: The memory store to update. `name` is taken from the URL.

update_mask.description: Only `description` and `metadata` may be updated. Selecting `metadata` replaces the entire map.

Fields to update. Only `metadata` is mutable; any other path returns
`INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE`.

Fields to update. Only `description` and `metadata` are mutable; any other
path returns `INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE`.
